search_perform_web_search: perform a web search using a configured search tool with query, max_results, and domain filters
search_list_available_tools: list all search tools configured in the litellm proxy router
search_perform_domain_filtered_search: perform a web search filtered to specific domains like arxiv.org and nature.com
search_perform_country_filtered_search: perform a web search with a country code filter such as US or GB
search_perform_perplexity_compatible_sea: perform a Perplexity-compatible search via POST to /v1/search with query and optional parameters
